goal: Eliminate redundant ring/bubble filesystem walks and memoize per-command evidence fingerprinting in recur warp while preserving cross-functional domain discovery and strict backwards compatibility.
invariants: Cross-functional domain discovery is preserved: Warp bubble maps, ring maps, slice layers, and external evidence manifests may live in any engineering discipline directory (warps/, docs/, boards/, blender/, manufacturing/, demos/, root ., or private .recur/work/) and must NEVER be hardcoded to warps/ or software-only source layouts.

.recur MUST remain discoverable by default (not added to DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_DIRS) so private Warp bubbles (.recur/*.warp-map.json and .recur/work/*.warp-map.json) tested in julia-tests/main.command.warp.discovery.test.jl continue to pass without modification.

Do NOT edit julia-tests/main.command.warp.discovery.test.jl (it is fingerprinted by watch-eventness evidence manifests); add new regression and latency tests in dedicated test files while keeping all 75+ assertions in main.command.warp.discovery.test.jl green.

[warp.discovery] roots and exclude_dirs in .recur/config.toml and --scan-all retain exact precedence and override semantics so any non-software or custom folder layout (even directories named build or fixtures) can opt in.
All Warp JSON schemas (warp-list-v1, warp-progress-v1, warp-bubble-projection-v1, warp-ring-projection-v1, warp-status-v1) and ambiguity/containment error messages remain unchanged.

Per-command evidence/canonicalization memoization lives strictly in memory for the duration of one read-only CLI invocation — never writing persistent cache files or serving stale disk state across invocations.
A failing baseline demonstrates the redundant-walk latency gap; it does not prove a fix or satisfy final acceptance.

observations: recur warp -d C:/src/recur took ~7,956 ms (compared to 114 ms on C:/src/kicad_ra) because main.improvement.34.implementation.warp-ring.json at repo root has 6 accepted worker domains, and parent_acceptance_state called load_warp_layers(root, warp) with local = false for each domain, walking 72,905 files in target/ and .git/ six times (~450,000 NTFS stat calls) via keep_entry.

keep_entry in src/main_command_warp_impl.rs only skipped '.recur' and failed to skip '.git', 'target', 'target2', 'build', 'dist', 'node_modules', or '__pycache__', while DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_DIRS in src/warp_discovery.rs omitted 'target2' and '__pycache__'.

bubble_progress (used by recur warp show <id>, recur warp slices <id>, and recur reveal <id>) called list_warps(root, true, false) first, composing and hashing external evidence across all 84 manifests in the workspace only to discard 83 of them.

warp_evidence::check repeatedly canonicalized, read, and FNV-1a hashed shared source files (such as Cargo.toml and src/main.rs) across checked gates in a single CLI invocation without an in-memory per-command memoization map.

final_state.description: recur warp, recur warp show, recur warp slices, and recur reveal <warp-id> respond in interactive sub-second time even in large polyglot/cross-functional repositories containing multi-gigabyte build/CAD/PCB caches, while keeping domain-agnostic manifest placement and every existing Warp discovery contract intact.
required_observations: merge_ring_inner reuses already-loaded coordinator layers in parent_acceptance_state instead of triggering repeated unbounded WalkDir scans from the ring root.

Recursive Warp queries (status, merge, map, explain, next, collapse-plan) skip .git and standard cross-stack build/cache folders (target, target2, build, dist, node_modules, __pycache__) alongside .recur unless explicitly targeted, while DiscoveryPolicy adds target2 and __pycache__ without excluding .recur.

bubble_progress resolves candidate {warp}.warp-map.json / {warp}.warp-ring.json paths under DiscoveryPolicy before composing only the matched Warp, preserving identical ambiguity, ring-kind, and containment diagnostics.
warp_evidence / list_warps memoize canonicalized file resolutions and FNV-1a content fingerprints in memory within a single CLI run with zero persistent state.

julia-tests/main.command.warp.discovery.test.jl passes untouched, and new cross-functional fixture tests verify sub-second discovery across mixed docs/CAD/hardware/code layouts with large ignored build/cache trees.
